CRITICAL • Overpayment Lines 42–56

Clause 4.2 & 8.2: 10-Month Security Deposit (₹2,50,000)

Statutory Rule: Karnataka Model Tenancy Act caps residential deposits at maximum 2 months rent (₹50,000). Overcommit required: ₹2,00,000.

Risk: Landlord retains unilateral authority to debit subjective repainting costs and enforce 45-day return lag.
CAUTION • Escalation Line 104

Clause 14.1: Unilateral 15% Rent Escalation

Standard Bengaluru locality indexation is 5% to 8% with 90 days mutual notice. This contract enforces an automatic 15% (₹3,750/mo increase) on Day 331 without tenant assent.

Impact: +₹45,000/yr
error MISSING CLAUSE Contract Gap

Maintenance & Structural Repair SLA

Zero mention of landlord liability for external seepage, core electrical lines, or elevator dues. In Karnataka, major structural repairs legally remain the lessor's duty.

Key Findings & Red Lines

  • Clause 4.2 (10-Mo Deposit): Violates Karnataka Model Tenancy Act which limits deposit to 2 months rent maximum for residential leases.
  • Clause 14.1 (15% Escalation): Out of line with market indexation (5%–8%). Recommended to replace with mutual review clause.
  • Clause 8.2 (Exit Penalty): Month 3 exit causes ₹75,000 forfeiture. Suggest reducing notice penalty to 30 days without liquidated damages.
  • Missing Annexure A: Landlord maintenance liability schedule was not attached to the scanned file.
